RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) Operating Framework
Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Operating Framework: The policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) serves as the anchor rate for money market interest rates. The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate operates at repo rate minus 25 bps (6.25% when repo is 6.50%), and the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) operates at repo rate plus 25 bps (6.75%). The MPC targets medium-term consumer price index (CPI) headline inflation of 4.0% within a +/- 2.0% tolerance band.

Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy: Repo Rate 6.50% & Liquidity Stance
Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Statement: The MPC decided by a 5 to 1 majority to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50%. Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate remains at 6.25% and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and Bank Rate at 6.75%. The stance of monetary policy was unanimously revised from 'withdrawal of accommodation' to 'NEUTRAL'. Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) of scheduled commercial banks is maintained at 4.50% of NDTL.

Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) & RBI Economic Data: India's Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew at 8.2% in FY 2023-24, retaining position as fastest growing major global economy. FY 2024-25 GDP growth is projected at 7.2% by RBI. Consumer Price Index (CPI) headline inflation is targeted at 4.0% (+/-2% tolerance band), with core inflation subdued at 3.1-3.5%. The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate operates at repo rate minus 25 bps (6.25% when repo is 6.50%), and the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) operates at repo rate plus 25 bps (6.75%). The MPC targets medium-term consumer price index (CPI) headline inflation of 4.0% within a +/- 2.0% tolerance band.

Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Statement: The MPC decided by a 5 to 1 majority to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50%. Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate remains at 6.25% and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and Bank Rate at 6.75%. The stance of monetary policy was unanimously revised from 'withdrawal of accommodation' to 'NEUTRAL'. Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) of scheduled commercial banks is maintained at 4.50% of NDTL.

Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) & RBI Economic Data: India's Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew at 8.2% in FY 2023-24, retaining position as fastest growing major global economy. FY 2024-25 GDP growth is projected at 7.2% by RBI. Consumer Price Index (CPI) headline inflation is targeted at 4.0% (+/-2% tolerance band), with core inflation subdued at 3.1-3.5%. findings.executive_thesis:
Strategic Recommendation: HOLD. Conviction 20/100. Target corridor INR 180-210. Stop-loss floor INR 165. Sequential architecture analysis indicates significant fundamental headwinds and technical oversold conditions, necessitating a defensive posture until margin stabilization occurs.

Quantitative & Order Flow Edge: RSI at 23.6 signals deep oversold territory, yet 47.4% annualized volatility remains elevated. Corwin-Schultz spread at 175.0 bps suggests high transaction costs. Derivatives data shows a neutral PCR of 0.95 with ATM IV at 16.5%. Execution mandate requires VWAP algorithmic slicing over 30-minute intervals to mitigate market impact given the 175 bps spread.

Corporate Performance & Macro Policy: Revenue stands at INR 3,601.50 Cr against a net loss of INR 625.50 Cr, yielding a -17.37% margin and -27.05% ROE. SEBI LODR compliance is clean. RBI repo rate at 6.50% and CPI at 5.49% provide a stable cost of capital environment, though high rates continue to compress growth-stage valuation multiples.

Adversarial Bounds & Capital Preservation: Stress testing confirms resilience to a 2x volatility shock with a 99% VaR of 13.90%. However, the asset fails the statutory drag test, as the annualized return of -76.63% is insufficient to offset the 22.22 bps roundtrip friction. Capital preservation is the primary objective; current metrics do not support aggressive accumulation.
